verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single line saying that, if Decision Center is enabled, policies can be configured at the Sale checkpoint and applied to orders. This implies a configurable policy layer, but nothing shows what policies can contain or which decisions they return. Missing for 10: evidence that rules can combine model scores, velocity counters, list matches and transaction attributes; explicit allow/block/review outcomes; an analyst-facing rule-authoring interface; and independent or hands-on corroboration.
